status: Partial Bloat, owned-eye and normal Charger implementation. No full port acceptance implied.

sources.supports: Bloat is 68.1.0, owned Bloat Eye is 68.11.0, normal Charger is 23.0.0. Bloat HP450/contact2/radius27; eye source HP450/contact1/radius13; Charger HP20/contact1/radius13.

Both eyes initially detached; short in-place hop releases a fixed-orientation eight-shot ring. Larger player-directed jump releases eight shots and a small red-creep patch. Large red-creep action; two nearly instant, untelegraphed lasers directed down or to both sides, never up. Green form replaces short/long-jump shots with two/three Ipecac shots, summons two Chargers on large creep and uses green creep in Repentance. Named eye-destruction exceptions.

Eye family floats diagonally over obstacles, bounces from walls/monsters, blocks shots, deals contact, responds to bombs, vanishes with its owner; component identity comes from installed XML rather than ambiguous wiki index numbers.

Normal Charger wanders slowly without pursuing; cardinal alignment triggers an immediate fast straight charge. Other variants have distinct rules and are not silently certified by the normal controller.
Bloat boss-family pool in Necropolis and Utero: DeathWard bands 2/3.

Positive ordinary Charger room templates in Caves/Catacombs/Flooded Caves and Womb/Utero/Scarred Womb/Sheol/Corpse support bands 1/3; band 2 ordinary selection removed. Green Bloat still summons Chargers in band 2.

implemented: Independent Bloat controller with fixed rings, short in-place and long directed swept jumps, red/green creep, immediate paired cardinal lasers and green form attacks.
Owned Bloat Eyes use independent owner/slot identities, refusal of mismatched eye family, retry after capacity failures, real flying collision/projectile interception and owner-only cleanup.
Owner-bound beam hazards, clipped to cover, real player hit volumes, source owner chain release and cancellation on death; no upward beam or advance warning delay.

Reusable projectile gravity/blast parameters: arcing green shots hit actual terrain/cover/player, explode once, do not apply duplicate contact-plus-blast damage, use current hostile/soft-demolition policy.
Normal Charger has externally configured slow aimless wandering, immediate cardinal acquisition with LOS, locked dash heading, collision/end recovery. Summoned Chargers remain normal room threats.
Dedicated weighted Bloat normal/green pools in Abandoned Works and Storm Cut; existing native bosses remain selectable. Ordinary Chargers use only bands 1/3.
Original procedural Bloat skin/socket/belly cues, green variant/projectiles/creep and actual beam/jump warnings; no proprietary Isaac art imported.

deathward_adaptations.hp: Bloat 450*3.2=1440; normal Charger 20*3.2=64. Invulnerable eye HP remains the local sentinel 1, not a source HP conversion.
deathward_adaptations.damage: Bloat contact 20, beams/shots/creep/eye/Charger contact 10, green blast 20 before hostile multiplier1.25. Starting player remains100 HP/24 damage.
deathward_adaptations.attacks: Local cooldown2.4/windup.5; large jump .9s, range7, apex3.8..6; short hop .35s/apex.7. Existing movement/aggression multipliers apply. Grounded/windup damageable; complete airborne immunity is explicit local policy, not verified source timing.
deathward_adaptations.lasers: Fixed world south corresponds to source down; two parallel front rays or opposed side rays from sockets. Range32/radius.32/duration.7/recovery1.5/alignment.8 are local. Geometry is clipped at creation; solid cover also guards damage. No added telegraph delay.
deathward_adaptations.creep: Large radius3, landing radius1, lifetime6. Nearby owned deposits refresh rather than unbounded stacking. Large creep action summons ordinary independent Chargers; they survive body death and must be cleared for room completion.
deathward_adaptations.ipecac: 1.1s aimed flight, gravity12, lateral spread2, explosion radius2.8/damage20; discrete swept 3D motion and flat-plane fallback only without canyon terrain. Hostile blast does not damage its own faction; it can ignite powder barrels using soft demolition. No player-Ipecac item, item damage formula, or generic poisoning status is implemented by this enemy attack.
deathward_adaptations.summon_bound: Configurable cap12 live/pending owned Chargers plus existing global limits; reaching the cap can reduce an otherwise two-child action. This bound is not asserted as native Isaac behavior.
deathward_adaptations.charger: Local dash11 before1.1 movement multiplier, maximum1.5s, alignment.8, recovery.7, wander timers.7..1.8; no anticipation windup. Native exact speed/timer/stop conditions require measurement.
deathward_adaptations.selection: Bands2/3 native weight6, Bloat normal3/green1. These weights are local, not source spawn odds. Dedicated stream leaves layout/ordinary selection RNG independent.

unresolved: Chaos Card, Euthanasia, God's Flesh and Little Horn eye-destruction exceptions remain unfinished; debug execution is not an implementation of these items.
Exact native attack probabilities/timers, laser acquisition geometry/recovery, jump immunity windows, Charger acceleration/stopping and any native summon cap are not established by article/XML data.
Champion/item/status/team interactions, additional dedicated/double/degraded routes and broader Charger variants remain open.
Green summoned-child survival and hostile-blast faction/demolition behavior use current DeathWard policies; native encounter edge cases require further verification.
All-camera readability, final silhouettes, human/mixed-build balance and controlled native/WASM performance acceptance remain open.
